original_metadata.cve_description: A vulnerability was found in jLEMS. It has been declared as critical. Affected by this vulnerability is the function unpackJar of the file src/main/java/org/lemsml/jlems/io/util/JUtil.java. The manipulation leads to path traversal. The attack can be launched remotely. The name of the patch is 8c224637d7d561076364a9e3c2c375daeaf463dc. It is recommended to apply a patch to fix this issue. The identifier VDB-216169 was assigned to this vulnerability.
